2608.03524.title: Dr. AGENTONOMICS: A Didactic Experiment of AGENTONOMICS
2608.03524.paper_summary: AGENTONOMICS is a framework that treats AI agents as economic entities that can be designed, managed, and governed through an integrated management architecture. Dr. AGENTONOMICS is its first application: a lecture agent developed in the context of the TUM course on AI agents in business administration. Conceived during the winter semester 2025/26 and first introduced to students in the summer semester 2026, it serves as a didactic experiment in which the agent is both the object that students study and the medium through which they learn and apply the framework. The current prototype is a web-based, retrieval-grounded tutor that explains AGENTONOMICS concepts and supports student questions. This report argues that the same system can grow beyond tutoring into three additional cumulative roles: an avatar lecturer that delivers multimodal instruction, a design consultant that guides students through the AGENTONOMICS Design & Management Reference Framework (ADMRF), and a meta-agent that helps construct the agents students have specified. These roles are cumulative because they share the same interface, intelligence layer, tools, knowledge base, and ecosystem connection, while an orchestrator selects the role-specific algorithm required for each task. We present the architecture of the prototype, outline its development roadmap, and discuss its implications for a polycentric AI economy. This report is intended to invite further discussion on how agents can teach, apply, and eventually reproduce the frameworks by which they are designed.
2608.03524.paper_summary_zh: AGENTONOMICS 是一個將 AI 代理視為經濟實體的框架，這些實體可以通過一個綜合管理架構進行設計、管理和治理。Dr. AGENTONOMICS 是其首個應用：一個在 TUM 商業管理課程中開發的講座代理。該代理在 2025/26 冬季學期構思，並在 2026 夏季學期首次向學生介紹，作為一個教學實驗，其中代理既是學生研究的對象，也是他們學習和應用該框架的媒介。當前原型是一個基於網絡的檢索驅動輔導工具，解釋 AGENTONOMICS 概念並支持學生提問。本報告主張，同一系統可以超越輔導，擴展為三個額外的累積角色：一個提供多模態教學的虛擬講師，一個指導學生通過 AGENTONOMICS 設計與管理參考框架 (ADMRF) 的設計顧問，以及一個幫助構建學生指定的代理的元代理。這些角色是累積的，因為它們共享相同的界面、智能層、工具、知識庫和生態系統連接，而一個協調者則選擇每個任務所需的角色特定算法。我們展示了原型的架構，概述了其開發路線圖，並討論了其對多中心 AI 經濟的影響。本報告旨在邀請進一步討論代理如何教學、應用，並最終再現其設計的框架。
